AppUseTimeReport.description_en: Used to report application usage duration on Tmall Genie devices.
AppUseTimeReport.description_zh: 用于在天猫精灵设备上上报应用的使用时长

CheckThirdRightSendPlan.description_en: Commercial mobile screen third-party app card issuance validation
CheckThirdRightSendPlan.description_zh: 商业化移动屏三方app领卡校验

CreateReminder.description_en: Used to create a reminder on a Tmall Genie device.
CreateReminder.description_zh: 用于在天猫精灵设备上创建提醒

DeleteReminder.description_en: User deletes a reminder created on a Tmall Genie device.
DeleteReminder.description_zh: 用户删除在天猫精灵设备上创建的提醒

GetAccountForApp.description_en: Used by developers to obtain membership information in business scenarios that depend on CatGenie Membership
GetAccountForApp.description_zh: 用于开发者在依赖于猫精会员的业务场景下获取会员信息

GetPhoneNumber.description_en: Obtain the phone number bound to the user's Maojing device. You must first request this capability on the Maojing Skill Application Platform and obtain user authorization on the device side.
GetPhoneNumber.description_zh: 获取用户在猫精设备绑定的手机号。需先在猫精技能应用平台进行能力申请，并在设备端得到用户授权

GetReminder.description_en: User retrieves reminders created on Tmall Genie devices.
GetReminder.description_zh: 用户获取在天猫精灵设备上创建的提醒

ListReminders.description_en: The User batch retrieves reminders created on Tmall Genie devices.
ListReminders.description_zh: 用户批量获取在天猫精灵设备上创建的提醒

PullCashier.description_en: The user launches the checkout page on a Tmall Genie device.
PullCashier.description_zh: 用户在天猫精灵设备上拉起收银台

PushNotifications.description_en: Execute the message push feature of Tmall Genie. You must first request the capability and configure the message template on the Tmall Genie Skill Application Platform
PushNotifications.description_zh: 执行天猫精灵的消息推送功能。需先在猫精技能应用平台进行能力申请和消息模板配置

SendNotifications.description_en: Execute the message push feature of Tmall Genie. You must first request the capability and configure the message template in the Tmall Genie Skill Application Platform
SendNotifications.description_zh: 执行天猫精灵的消息推送功能。需先在猫精技能应用平台进行能力申请和消息模板配置

UpdateReminder.description_en: The user updates a reminder created on a Tmall Genie device.
UpdateReminder.description_zh: 用户更新在天猫精灵设备上创建的提醒

VideoAppReport.description_en: Used by developers to report membership information in scenarios involving membership collaboration with CatGenie
VideoAppReport.description_zh: 用于开发者在与猫精进行会员合作的场景下上报其会员信息

WakeUpApp.description_en: On a smart speaker with a screen, proactively launch the MeowGenie screen-display application. You must first request this capability on the MeowGenie skill application platform
WakeUpApp.description_zh: 在带屏音箱上，主动唤起猫精的屏显应用。需先在猫精技能应用平台进行能力申请
